judgement.reason: Tuwunel stores all homeserver data in an embedded RocksDB database on local disk, with no PostgreSQL or MySQL option, and Deployz provides no persistent volume to hold it.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (database_path = /database (nix/pkgs/complement/config.toml)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: The selected Dockerfile also sets database_path to /database for its RocksDB store, and no shown setting moves that durable data to a supported managed database, so a persistent disk is still needed.
